hebrewText: וַ/יִּתְפַּלֵּ֨ל חִזְקִיָּ֜הוּ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֮ וַ/יֹּאמַר֒ יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב הַ/כְּרֻבִ֔ים אַתָּה ה֤וּא הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ לְ/בַדְּ/ךָ֔ לְ/כֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ אַתָּ֣ה עָשִׂ֔יתָ אֶת הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וְ/אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ

tokens.bdb: to judge (officially or mentally); by extension, to intercede, pray
tokens.kjv: intreat, judge(-ment), (make) pray(-er, -ing), make supplication.
tokens.explanation: to judge ; by extension

tokens.bdb: Chizkijah, a king of Judah, also the name of two other Israelites
tokens.kjv: Hezekiah, Hizkiah, Hizkijah. Compare H3169 (יְחִזְקִיָּה).
tokens.explanation: Chizkijah

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
tokens.explanation: YHWH — Nome próprio de Deus revelado a Moisés. Tradição massorética lê "Adonai"

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

tokens.bdb: dominion, i.e. (abstractly) the estate (rule) or (concretely) the country (realm)
